title: SO-V29-08 O4 Observations
description: During one evening in the canal hamlet of Pellwick, the player and their capable partner Arin trace an unaccounted-for delivery of lamp oil from the receiving quay to the communal lamp room.

qualities.rubric: Has the player examined the delivery docket on the receiving quay during this outing?
Has the player examined the empty unloading cradle on the receiving quay during this outing?
Has the player entered the weigh shed during this outing?
Has the player examined the scale platform inside the weigh shed during this outing?
Has the player entered the wash court from the weigh shed during this outing?
Has the player examined the drain grate in the wash court during this outing?
Has the player reached the hoist landing from the wash court during this outing?
Has the player examined the freight basket at the hoist landing during this outing?
Has the player entered the upstairs lamp room during this outing?
Has the player lifted the canvas covering the storage rack in the lamp room during this outing?

checkpoints.name: Receiving Quay
checkpoints.objective: Begin with Arin at Pellwick's receiving quay: the evening lamp-oil delivery is unaccounted for, and the adjoining weigh shed begins the route through the depot.

checkpoints.name: Weigh Shed
checkpoints.objective: Trace the delivery through the weigh shed, whose far doorway opens onto the wash court.

checkpoints.name: Wash Court
checkpoints.objective: Continue tracing the delivery across the wash court to the adjacent hoist landing.

checkpoints.name: Hoist Landing
checkpoints.objective: Examine the freight-hoist area; a short staircase beside it leads to the upstairs lamp room.

checkpoints.name: Lamp Room
checkpoints.objective: Finish accounting for the delivery among the lamp room's storage racks and report the result with Arin.

observations.text: The evening docket lists one blue-banded oil drum, with its destination printed as 'Lamp Room'.
Two narrow wheel tracks run from the empty unloading cradle to the weigh-shed doorway.
The wheel tracks cross the shed floor and curve through the doorway into the wash court.
A round wet print spans the scale platform, with a flake of blue paint caught at its edge.
A hose lies across the wet court; narrow wheel tracks continue through the water toward the hoist landing.
Blue paint flakes cling to the drain grate among pale soap bubbles.
The freight hoist's pointer rests beside 'Lamp Room'; fresh water beads on its lower loading sill.
The empty freight basket has a drum-sized wet circle on its floor and a curved blue smear on its rail.
Damp wheel tracks run from the upper hoist doors to a canvas-covered storage rack.
Beneath the canvas stands a blue-banded oil drum with an intact wax seal and a paper tag reading 'Evening delivery — reserve rack'.

roster.name: Arin
roster.role: a capable companion on the night shift
